verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's Create Event API tracks a specific profile's activity and accepts arbitrary, schema-free data, and the mobile SDKs also capture custom events. Separate docs say flows can be set up on Klaviyo events and automations can be built, so a custom per-person event can drive an automation for that profile. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a custom API-created metric triggers a flow for exactly that profile (the flow-trigger evidence is a gift-notification example), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
